name: Haskell
note: Pure functional language with non-strict (lazy) evaluation
runtime: Compiled to native (GHC), with RTS providing GC and green threads

runtimes.name: Native (GHC RTS)
runtimes.role: AOT compiled; the runtime provides GC and lightweight green threads.

runtimes.name: GHCi
runtimes.role: Interactive environment that can execute interpreted bytecode and loaded object code.

runtimes.name: WebAssembly (GHC wasm backend)
runtimes.role: Emerging support for compiling Haskell to WASM.

compilers.name: GHC
compilers.role: The Glasgow Haskell Compiler; the de-facto standard.

compilers.name: GHC (LLVM backend)
compilers.role: Alternative native-code generator built on LLVM.

concurrencyModel: Lightweight green threads (forkIO), STM (Software Transactional Memory), sparks for parallelism

codeExample.source:
module Main where

fib :: Int -> Int
fib 0 = 0
fib 1 = 1
fib n = fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)

main :: IO ()
main = mapM_ (print . fib) [0..9]
